approximations: No precontact spontaneous firing injected; quiescent model background is not a measured in-vivo baseline.
First-second recorded means are transferred uniformly within source-proposed receptor classes, not claimed as measurements from every MaleCNS cell.
Constant first-second drive preserves the reported mean window; onset/adaptation shape is unresolved.
Mixed is selective sweet+bitter channel coactivation, not a calibrated chemical sucrose+caffeine mixture; peripheral suppression and interactions are not implemented.
Water-driven ingestion and caffeine aversion are state dependent; no gut/hunger state is inferred or trained.

dynamics.transmitter_signs: existing fast proxy: ACh positive; GABA/glutamate/histamine negative; ambiguous/modulator-only positive, 3718 uncertain neurons

gates.generator: per-group binomial two-sided p>=1e-6 against requested event rate; per-cell events and actual spikes reported separately
gates.numerical: finite voltage/synaptic state abs<=1e6 mV, <5% neurons exceed 100 Hz averaged across trial, zero prestimulus activity
gates.repeat: exact counts, sampled traces and input event bins for sweet seed17
gates.response: each seed sweet and water MN9 mean >1 Hz; mean bitter <=water; mixed MN9 mean <sweet for every common seed

interpretation: Conditional source-informed taste-channel stimulation in a quiescent Shiu-style model. Exact source-proposed cell identities; homogeneous cross-specimen rate transfer and a constant 1-second waveform are modeling assumptions. Not a reproduced natural food exposure, acquired learning, or sports result.
label: sensory-assay-01-physiology-window-proxy

source_measurements.age: 2–3-day flies transferred to fresh medium one day before recording
source_measurements.baseline_correction: none stated for extracellular counts; these are recorded first-second spike frequencies

bitter.sensillum: i-type Gr66a control; transfer to broad 38-cell source-proposed Gr33a LB1a-d population, exact bristle subclasses unresolved

source_measurements.electrolyte: 1 mM KCl in all test solutions

sweet.sensillum: l-type; population transfer to 34 source-proposed Gr64f LB3b/c cells

water.sensillum: l-type; transfer to 17 source-proposed ppk28 LB3a cells

stopping: Complete finite controls; stop immediately for numerical/generator/runtime failure; no two-probe or sports expansion unless response and repeat gates pass. Any revision receives a new identity before running.
